Lula criticizes intervention, backs China peace plan at UN

Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated at the UN that Brazil needs cooperation, not intervention, to combat crime. He also backed China's peace initiative and asserted that Brazil is "no one's backyard," signaling a stance against being dictated to by other nations, particularly the US. Lula also commented on the Gaza conflict, stating its "pain and trauma" will endure for generations.
